name: Compiler access: internal types, default imports, unresolved is
description: Checks that execute_code and scripts name a loaded assembly's top-level internal types (Utility_Mod.Main, BroMakerLib.ModUI, BroMakerLib.Unlocks.BroUnlockManager, RocketLib.UMM.Main, the game's global SteamManager), by full name and through a using, that a public type keeps winning over an internal one of the same full name (System.Tuple from mcs over 0Harmony's) and over an internal global type a simple name would otherwise find first (Rewired.Consts through a using over the global internal Consts), that two internal types a simple name finds through usings are ambiguous (Main with using Utility_Mod) while the default imports alone give the mod's own Main, that a using alias and a using static to an internal type work and an internal script class can derive from one, that System.IO and System.Text are imported by default, that the game's global Math still resolves, that an is operand naming a type that does not exist reports the missing type, qualified and simple, in execute_code and in a script, instead of an internal compiler error, that a typo in a constant pattern reports the missing member, and that a number or enum constant pattern on an object runs in execute_code, also after a failed compile, and in a script, and that a wildcard and a var pattern as the operand run in execute_code. Needs Utility Mod, BroMakerLib and RocketLib installed and enabled in the profile. Its first steps unload the scripts an earlier failed run left loaded.
